budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Serve two hot courses and two chilled desserts using three trays, six total ingredients, two portable ice boxes and a finite cooling/fuel reserve.
task.natural_termination: Success when both served counts reach two. Failure when remaining pantry stock plus raw/processing/ready portions of either type cannot supply that type's remaining demand. Spoiled food is irrecoverable.
task.interaction: A moved box changes both walkability and nearby tray temperatures; it can preserve a peer dessert but chill another peer hot course. Door access spends shared cooling, while cooling/refill/processing/washing and one shared corridor couple the cooks' schedules.
task.observation_access: Fully observable. The flat public obs_keys vector includes every cook/item position, carrier, type, food, processing state, temperature, freshness, clock, portable charge, map, door state, cooling/fuel store, station, ingredient and service counter, and per-step event. The chilled flag reports cooling actually applied on the just-finished step, not a promise of cooling after reserves deplete. All active entities are visible to all roles; human and policy information is identical.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Correct-temperature portions served this step, hot then dessert.
Tray completed native processing this step.
Per-tray cooling actually applied in this step.
Cumulative ingredients discarded at washing by type.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
